description: Na₂CoH₄(SeO₅)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one Na₂CoH₄(SeO₅)₂ sheet oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(1), np.int64(0)) direction. Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.43 Å. Co is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.90 Å) and two longer (2.18 Å) Co-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. Se is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Se-O bond distances ranging from 1.68-1.90 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Co and one Se atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Co, and one O atom. The O-O bond length is 1.48 Å. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Se atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na and two H atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Se, and one O atom.
